name: notification-center
title: Notification center
description: A bell button with an unread count that opens a list of notifications, with mark read, clear and an empty state.
a11y: The bell is a button named 'Notifications, 3 unread'; the visible count badge is aria-hidden so the number is announced once.
The panel is a labelled dialog: Escape or an outside click closes it and focus returns to the bell.
Unread items are bold, start with a visually hidden 'Unread:' and have a 'Mark read' button named after the item; unread is never shown by colour alone.
'Mark all read' and 'Clear all' are disabled when they have nothing to do; an empty list shows plain text.

props.name: notifications
props.description: The notifications, newest first. You own this list: update it in the callbacks below.

props.name: onMarkRead
props.description: Called with the id when the user marks one notification as read. Hides that item's "Mark read" button once `read` is true.

props.name: onMarkAllRead
props.description: Called when the user chooses "Mark all read". The button is disabled when nothing is unread.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when the user chooses "Clear all". The button is disabled when the list is empty.

props.name: label
props.description: Name of the bell button and the panel. Default "Notifications".

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when there are no notifications. Default "You're all caught up."
